item.description: Kuomintang legislator Wu Tsung-hsien lost the Yilan magistrate election, failing to defend the Taiwanese opposition party’s leadership in the northeastern county against Democratic Progressive Party challenger Lin Kuo-chang. The KMT held the magistrate post in Yilan from 2018 to 2024 under Lin Zi-miao, who was suspended that December over corruption charges. Her deputy Lin Mao-sheng has served as acting magistrate since then. The local election outcome serves as a key midterm indicator for...

item.author: Reuters
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.description: In a country of frequent ⁠mass shootings, the December 14, 2012, massacre at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, Connecticut, has stood out. A ⁠lone gunman fired 154 rounds in under five minutes, killing 20 first-grade schoolchildren, aged six and seven, and six adults. Connecticut lawmakers quickly responded to the deadliest junior school shooting in US history by extending the state’s ban on what it refers to as “assault weapons” to include the AR-15 and other semi-automatic rifles like...

item.description: Kuomintang candidate Lee Shu-chuan won the New Taipei City mayoral election on Saturday, extending the party’s 21-year leadership in Taiwan’s most populous municipality, which has more than 4 million residents. Democratic Progressive Party lawmaker Su Chiao-hui conceded defeat in the key electoral battleground, which serves as a barometer of the island’s political direction. The KMT has maintained leadership in the area since 2005, when it was still Taipei county. Lee, 68, is a technocrat with...

item.description: The Kuomintang suffered a major setback in central Taiwan’s key battleground of Taichung on Saturday as Johnny Chiang Chi-chen lost to Democratic Progressive Party legislator Ho Hsin-chun in the mayoral race. The defeat ends eight years of rule by Taiwan’s main opposition party under outgoing mayor Lu Shiow-yen. Widely viewed as Taiwan’s main swing seat and a key general electoral bellwether, Taichung has alternated between KMT and DPP control over the past two decades. Chiang, a former KMT...
item.title: Taiwan elections: KMT’s Johnny Chiang loses key Taichung race in possible 2028 blow

item.description: A charity set up by the family of a British World War II veteran who raised tens of millions of pounds by walking laps of his garden during the coronavirus pandemic has applied to be disbanded, two years after the country’s charity watchdog found “repeated” financial misconduct. item.author: Gabriel Dominguez
item.dc:creator: Gabriel Dominguez
item.description: The United States is a step closer to restoring atomic weapons to its attack submarines, with Raytheon announcing on Tuesday it has a US Navy deal to advance development of a nuclear-armed cruise missile – a capability Washington retired in 2013. item.author: SCMP Reporter
item.dc:creator: SCMP Reporter
item.description: Kuomintang candidate Ko Chih-en lost the Kaohsiung mayoral election on Saturday, falling short in her bid to flip control of the southern port city after an intense campaign. Three-term lawmaker Lai Jui-lung of the Democratic Progressive Party won the race, extending the ruling party’s governance in the southern stronghold. Analysts view Taiwan’s local election results as an early indicator for the 2028 island-wide leadership election, serving as a midterm test for the ruling DPP’s political...

item.dc:creator: Lawrence Chung,Holly Chik
item.description: Taipei Mayor Wayne Chiang Wan-an secured a second term on Saturday, fending off an unexpectedly strong challenge from the ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) in a closely watched election. The victory marked a major boost for the main opposition Kuomintang (KMT) ahead of Taiwan’s 2028 leadership race and underscored the resilience of its traditional electoral base in the island’s capital despite an emerging social media-driven political movement. “I thank the great citizens of Taipei for...
item.title: KMT holds Taipei as Mayor Wayne Chiang fends off fierce DPP challenge

Kuomintang candidate Wei Ping-cheng lost the Changhua county magistrate election on Saturday against Democratic Progressive Party challenger Chen Su-yueh in a pivotal contest for central Taiwan. Changhua is the smallest county by area on Taiwan’s main island but is its most populous, with 1.2 million residents.

item.description: An explosion near a school in Afghanistan’s northeastern Kunar province killed seven students and injured up ‌to 99 others on Saturday, a spokesperson for the Taliban Interior Ministry said. item.dc:creator: Amber Wang
item.description: Legislator Chen Yu-jen from Taiwan’s main opposition party Kuomintang declared victory in the Quemoy county race on Saturday afternoon, putting her on track to become the offshore island’s first female magistrate. Quemoy, also known as Kinmen, sits just kilometres off the coast of mainland China’s Fujian province. item.dc:creator: Fiona Sun

item.dc:creator: Agence France-Presse
item.description: Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez urged voters on Friday to prevent Spain from moving “backwards” as campaigning ended for an election expected to deliver a victory for conservatives and the far-right. The outcome of Sunday’s vote will be closely watched as Europe opens an electoral cycle over the next 12 months that could reshape the balance of power within the European Union (EU). item.dc:creator: Kevin McSpadden
item.description: When Mongol leader Kublai Khan launched one of the largest naval invasions in human history in 1281, he was seeking a place to resettle a defeated Chinese army – and Japan was in his sights. But conquering Japan proved a vexing challenge for Kublai Khan’s military ambitions, and a typhoon sent the massive armada to the bottom of the sea. A campaign intended to cement the overthrow of China’s Southern Song dynasty (1127–1279) would become a rallying cry in Japan for centuries. A recent discovery...

item.description: Saudi Arabia’s highest-budget action film, 7 Dogs, will debut in Chinese cinemas on Saturday, marking the first theatrical release of a Saudi feature in the country and underscoring the rapidly expanding cultural ties between Beijing and Riyadh. item.author: Agence France-Presse
item.dc:creator: Agence France-Presse
item.description: Several cities in Peru and Ecuador faced major flooding on Friday after downpours in the region linked to the exceptionally strong El Nino climate phenomenon. In Piura, capital of the eponymous region in northern Peru, waist-high water filled city streets following 12 hours of heavy rain that began on Thursday. Some 2,000 families have been impacted by the rains in Piura, according to preliminary reports, National Institute of Civil Defence chief Luis Vasquez told the RPP radio station. All the...

item.dc:creator: Roetta Wang
item.description: After a 16-hour journey from Belgium, Lisa De Vriese arrived at Hong Kong International Airport exhausted and in pain. The 34-year-old illustrator lives with hypermobility spectrum disorder (HSD), a chronic condition that causes daily pain, fatigue and joint instability. She struggles with both prolonged standing and sitting, and making her way through immigration and customs during her visit in November left her feeling panicked. item.dc:creator: Cannix Yau
item.description: Tears welled up in the eyes of the fiancée of firefighter Ho Wai-ho, who was killed in the city’s deadliest blaze in decades, as she joined his brother on Saturday to accept a posthumous bravery medal from Hong Kong’s leader, days after the first anniversary of the inferno. item.description: Canadian prosecutors on Friday requested a 25-year prison sentence for a man who sold poison to help people take their own lives, stressing his victims were largely young and experiencing mental distress. Former chef Kenneth Law pleaded guilty earlier this year to aiding 14 suicides in Canada, but he has admitted to selling hundreds of so-called suicide kits globally through a series of online forums. item.description: It was no happy accident that last week’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit took place in Shenzhen. The futuristic southern metropolis is home to the nation’s technology champions and provides the ideal backdrop for China’s economic transformation and vision. item.description: About 200 people have been evacuated after a fire broke out at an industrial building in Hong Kong’s Tuen Mun when exterior scaffolding caught alight. item.description: Indian authorities have found a sample of Bisleri-branded water to be unsafe due to coliform bacteria, a regulatory document shows, the second such finding to come to light in recent days on the nation’s biggest ‌and most popular packaged-water brand. Bisleri’s 20-US cent bottles have made the company a household name in India, where poor water quality has turned bottled water into a necessity for homes and restaurants.
